description: Sanitized results from completed published-artifact verification; preparing this document did not rerun runtime tests.

proofs.scope: Published root/quickstart and RPC providers; isolated consumer, GOWORK=off.
proofs.compiler: Apple Clang 21 with matching Xcode SDK
proofs.methodology: Reviewed public example driver/goldens; published quickstart fixture imported directly; browser transport copied from published root. Harness changes restricted to GOWORK=off, scope text and published-admin identity recording.

proofs.scope: Downloaded command module and version-pinned installed CLI with published generator; no protected admin HTTP claim.

resolvedEnvironmentFailures.issue: Offline complete-graph lookup lacked cached module metadata.
resolvedEnvironmentFailures.resolution: Fetched missing metadata from public Go proxy; repeated complete graph check offline successfully.

resolvedEnvironmentFailures.issue: Forced toolchain selection required checksum metadata unavailable with the offline harness settings.
resolvedEnvironmentFailures.resolution: Used the cached Go executable directly with GOTOOLCHAIN=local; proof passed.

resolvedEnvironmentFailures.issue: Swift-provided Clang was incompatible with the installed Xcode SDK; a direct compiler invocation without SDKROOT also lacked C headers.
resolvedEnvironmentFailures.resolution: Used system Clang with matching SDKROOT for the successful admin proof; no global settings changed.

notRun.check: Full admin graph on its declared minimum Go toolchain
Other TypeScript/Node versions, operating systems and arbitrary mixed provider releases
Production authentication policy, durable idempotency/receipt recovery, native-device behavior and application acceptance

limitations: Structural comparison does not establish semantic compatibility, authorization or replay safety.
Startup readiness checks capability availability and intended exposure, not per-actor grants.
Local source/workspace proofs do not establish published-artifact compatibility.
sanitization: Allowlisted module identities, graph selections, relative source hashes, normalized commands, toolchain versions and aggregate outcomes only. No raw HTTP exchanges, credentials, tokens, user identifiers, host paths, temporary paths or private context links.
